Introduction
This
document outlines the Minor 
Maintenance procedure P1 , which must be performed 
every 6 year bases as indicated by Y6 in the above title block.
The 
first draft initiated at 
Portable Eslah UE zone
Safety Precautions
The main and control circuit must 
be completely disconnected
Air pressure of the pneumatic 
operating mechanism should be discharged from the drain valve of the air 
reservoir.
A work permit must be issued,
The qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution 
marks surrounding the work area,
Appropriate personal protective tools must be used, safety 
 shoes, helmet breathing mask, safety glasses
The main and control circuit must 
be completely disconnected
Air pressure of the pneumatic 
operating mechanism should be discharged from the drain valve of the air 
reservoir.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, gloves, and shoes,
Complete set of tools .
Gas detector.
Work to be Carried Out
The main and control circuit must 
be completely disconnected and air pressure of the pneumatic operating mechanism 
should be discharged from the drain valve of the air reservoir.
Check the setting of gas pressure switch.
Check the setting of air pressure switch.
Check the control wiring for loose connection.
Check the another bolts for loosening..
Check the auxiliary switch contacts.
Check the mechanical linkage for loose connection.
check pipe fittings and tighten pipe connections.
Check the gas leakage.
Check the pneumatic operating mechanism.
